evidence.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import csv, json
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('.')
split = json.loads((root/'experiments/stage10/07_large_eval/D_EVAL_STAGE10_V1_SPLIT_SUMMARY.json').read_text())
large = json.loads((root/'experiments/stage10/07_large_eval/LARGE_EVAL_SUMMARY.json').read_text())
meta = json.loads((root/'experiments/stage10/08_meta/STAGE10_META_ANALYSIS.json').read_text())
with (root/'experiments/stage10/07_large_eval/TOKEN_WEIGHTED_EVAL.csv').open(newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    token_rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))
source_counts = Counter(r['source_endpoint_type'] for r in token_rows)
recover_completed_100m = sum(1 for r in token_rows if r['source_endpoint_type']=='Y_recover' and r['status']=='completed_s10_12_eval' and r['training_budget_tokens']=='100000000')
selectors = {r['selector_name']: r for r in meta['selector_metrics']}
cfc_cost = selectors['CFC-only']['mean_cost_to_contain_winner']
contenders = ['LoopCert-only','family-balanced blend','risk-calibrated blend','Pareto-front']
out = {
    'split_version': split['split_version'],
    'split_count': split['split_count'],
    'record_count': split['record_count'],
    'split_status': split['status'],
    'recovery_overlap_count': split['split_boundary_audit']['recovery_overlap_count'],
    'large_eval_status': large['status'],
    'expected_formal_endpoint_rows': large['expected_formal_endpoint_rows'],
    'evaluated_endpoint_rows': large['evaluated_endpoint_rows'],
    'total_table_rows_including_original': large['total_table_rows_including_original'],
    'token_weighted_eval_csv_rows': len(token_rows),
    'source_endpoint_type_counts': dict(source_counts),
    'completed_100m_y_recover_rows': recover_completed_100m,
    'gate_verdict': meta['gate_results']['gate_verdict'],
    'ce_selection_gate_passed': meta['gate_results']['ce_selection_gate_passed'],
    'cfc_baseline_retained': meta['gate_results']['cfc_baseline_retained'],
    'closed_reasons': meta['gate_results']['closed_reasons'],
    'cfc_mean_cost_to_contain_winner': cfc_cost,
    'contenders_vs_cfc_cost': {name: {'mean_cost_to_contain_winner': selectors[name]['mean_cost_to_contain_winner'], 'delta_vs_cfc': selectors[name]['delta_mean_cost_to_contain_winner_vs_cfc_only'], 'beats_cfc_cost': selectors[name]['beats_cfc_only_on_mean_cost_to_contain_winner']} for name in contenders},
}
print(json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True))
PY
